# Open Ruler

> Open Ruler (openruler.design) is a free tool for designers. It generates realistic, client-style design briefs for practice, lets designers build a portfolio from the work they make, and share it with a community.

## What you can do
- Generate a design brief by discipline (brand & identity, packaging, editorial, UI/UX, motion, and more), industry and timeline: https://openruler.design/new
- Browse work from the community: https://openruler.design/community
- Take part in the weekly design challenge: https://openruler.design/weekly-challenge
- Create a free account and a public portfolio: https://openruler.design/signup
